```{r}
# Install libraries if necessary
# install.packages("here")
# install.packages("dplyr")
# install.packages("readr")

# Load necessary libraries
library(here)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)

# Read the data
data <- read_csv("/Users/tur61139/Documents/GitHub/rf1-sra-socdoors/mriqc-metrics_DoorsSocDoors_n_ses-01.csv")

# Sublist of all potential subjects for MRIQC
keep_ids <- read.table("/Users/tur61139/Documents/GitHub/rf1-sra-linux2/code/sublist_all.txt")
keep_ids_vec <- keep_ids$V1

# Compute subjects in keep_ids but not in MRIQC data
need <- setdiff(keep_ids_vec, unique(data$sub))

# Compute subjects in MRIQC but not in keep_ids
MRIQC_only <- setdiff(unique(data$sub), keep_ids_vec)

cat("Subjects in keep ids but not in MRIQC data (for UGR, should match behavioral data tracker; other tasks, you should have a behavioral data tracker sheet!):\n", need, "\n")
cat("Subjects in MRIQC but not in keep ids (can delete):\n", MRIQC_only, "\n")


# Remove non-Doors/Social Doors data, only use relevant subjects
data <- data |> 
  filter(task %in% c("doors", "socialdoors"),
         sub %in% keep_ids_vec)
n_distinct(data$sub)

## Remove references to lower bounds, if the participant was a reduced motion outlier, great! Moved their head less
# Function to determine if a value is an outlier (upper bound only)
# High outliers (for fd_mean)
is_high_outlier <- function(x) {
  Q3 <- quantile(x, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
  Q1 <- quantile(x, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
  IQR <- Q3 - Q1
  upper_bound <- Q3 + 1.5 * IQR
  return(ifelse(x > upper_bound, "outlier", "non-outlier"))
}

# Low outliers (for tsnr) 
# If high signal, great! Stronger signal
is_low_outlier <- function(x) {
  Q3 <- quantile(x, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
  Q1 <- quantile(x, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
  IQR <- Q3 - Q1
  lower_bound <- Q1 - 1.5 * IQR
  return(ifelse(x < lower_bound, "outlier", "non-outlier"))
}

data <- data |>
  mutate(
    fd_outlier = is_high_outlier(fd_mean),
    tsnr_outlier = is_low_outlier(tsnr)
  )


# Identify fd and tsnr outliers BEFORE subsetting data
fd_outliers <- data %>% filter(fd_outlier == "outlier")
tsnr_outliers <- data %>% filter(tsnr_outlier == "outlier")

# Report fd_mean outliers
outliers <- data %>% filter(fd_outlier == "outlier")
cat("Number of FD outliers:", nrow(outliers), "\nSubjects:", unique(outliers$sub), "\n")

# Report tsnr outliers
tsnr_outliers <- data %>% filter(tsnr_outlier == "outlier")
cat("Number of tSNR outliers:", nrow(tsnr_outliers), "\nSubjects:", unique(tsnr_outliers$sub), "\n")

# Remove only rows marked as outliers
clean_data <- data %>%
  filter(fd_outlier != "outlier", tsnr_outlier != "outlier")

# Final subject list (based on retained rows)
keep_ids <- unique(clean_data$sub)
cat("Number of subjects with at least one usable run (no outlier rows):", length(keep_ids), "\n")
cat("Final keep_ids:\n", paste(keep_ids, collapse = ", "))

# Save filtered data
write_csv(clean_data, here("analyses", "mriqc-metrics_outliers.csv"))

```

```{r}
# fd_mean box plots
ggplot(data, aes(x = factor(sub), y = fd_mean)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, fill = "lightblue", color = "darkblue", alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, size = 1.5, alpha = 0.7, aes(color = fd_outlier)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("non-outlier" = "darkblue", "outlier" = "red")) +
  labs(
    title = "fd_mean by Subject for Each Run",
    x = "Subject",
    y = "Average fd_mean",
    color = "Outlier Status"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8, angle = 90, vjust = 0.5),  # Rotate for readability
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12))

# tsnr box plots
ggplot(data, aes(x = factor(sub), y = tsnr)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, fill = "green2", color = "green4", alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, size = 1.5, alpha = 0.7, aes(color = tsnr_outlier)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("non-outlier" = "green4", "outlier" = "red")) +
  labs(
    title = "tsnr by Subject for Each Run",
    x = "Subject",
    y = "Average fd_mean",
    color = "Outlier Status"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8, angle = 90, vjust = 0.5),  # Rotate for readability
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12)
  )
```
